text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays to you, Trainer. The
Mejiro family
does host the most
wonderful parties...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But this year, I'd rather celebrate in
different
company, at a cozier gathering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In line with Mejiro Bright's wishes, I
arrange for
her to celebrate with some of
her peers.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bright! Trainer! Hello! Thank you for
inviting me
along to this fated and
festive shindig!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Bright... We're going to exchange gifts
today,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes! There'll be heartfelt gifts for
each of us.
I expect it'll be wonderful
fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the gift-giving begins. First,
Silence
Suzuka readies her gift for
Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru... This is for you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh? What could this be? How curious. It
appears to be wrapped... inside a
plastic
shopping bag from a convenience
store?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's where I bought them. It's some
gum, a
charger... Oh, and some salt and
pepper.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Salt and pepper?! Whatever for?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm sure I can use it to exorcise
something
or other! Appreciated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I think it might be my turn next. This is
from me to
you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten you a hair clip. It's just
perfect for
your beautiful hair.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you, really. But, um, Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like all I do is take. You've given
me so
many invaluable gifts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Suzuka... Teehee. But that's just how
I feel
too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Right, so that just leaves my present for Bright. Okay, my present for you is a big, total...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mystery!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Wowww... A secret present? Whatever
could it
be?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's just say that's under wraps for now.
It's not
ready to be revealed yet, so I'll
not be divulging
any details...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But I guarantee all will come to light
within the
year! Wait with bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It sounds like she has something big in
the
works. Let's wait and see what it is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... It was so much fun spending this
special
day as a quartet. ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today, our bonds as contemporaries felt
stronger
than ever!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's different when we're together.
We share
so many memories...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before parting ways for the night, why
don't we
all go stargazing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I hope that we can continue walking
beside one
another forevermore...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka closes her eyes, Mejiro
Bright
brings her hands together, and

Matikanefukukitaru claps twice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their three wishes join snugly together
before
fading away into the starry night
sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once the other two leave...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think I'd like something from
you, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I could trouble you for a
present
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's quite all right. What you have
with you
will more than suffice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I don't have anything nice that
would make a
decent present. I wonder
what she's talking
about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee! What I'd like from you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is your future, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd like for you to share your future
with the
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright says this with a big grin on
her face,
but the look in her eyes tells
me she's not entirely
joking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I'm being self-indulgent... And
I've made
what sounds like an
unreasonable request... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's not quite right. You see,
it's... the
will of
the Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family needs you. We need
you if
we're to go on shining into the
future forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My older sisters say that no house
can
flourish on its own strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's vital that we meet new
people—people who
can introduce us to
new ideas and ways of
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and I'm not the one... who's been
waiting for
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family itself has been. And it
has been
for a very long time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's voice seems to carry a
will greater
than hers alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look up, and there it is—a river of
starlight
flowing through the
generations.
